title: ScreenASR-Bench: A Tiered Benchmark for Speech Recognition with Visual Context
abstract: arXiv:2610.16260v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current ASR models perform well on general benchmarks but still struggle with acoustically ambiguous words. Visual context can aid recognition in screen-based scenarios, yet existing benchmarks provide limited insight into the benefits of different types of visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ScreenASR-Bench , a tiered benchmark with three progressively challenging levels: Explicit Textual Evidence (ETE), based on direct on-screen text; Explicit Visual Evidence (EVE), using visible content rather than on-screen text; and Implicit Semantic Evidence (ISE), requiring scene-level inference. Extensive experiments on ASR models, Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) and Omni models show that incorporating visual context substantially improves recall over the audio-only setting across all three model families. The gains are largest for ETE and smallest for ISE, indicating that models leverage direct visual evidence more effectively

translated_title: ScreenASR-Bench：一个面向带视觉上下文语音识别的分层基准
translated_abstract: 当前的自动语音识别（ASR）模型在通用基准上表现良好，但在处理声学上模糊的词汇时仍然存在困难。视觉上下文可以在基于屏幕的场景中辅助识别，然而现有基准对于不同类型视觉证据所带来的收益提供的洞察有限。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了ScreenASR-Bench，一个包含三个难度递进层级的分层基准：显式文本证据（ETE），基于屏幕上直接显示的文本；显式视觉证据（EVE），利用可见内容而非屏幕文本；以及隐式语义证据（ISE），需要进行场景级推理。在ASR模型、大型音频-语言模型（LALM）和全模态模型上的大量实验表明，与仅使用音频的设置相比，引入视觉上下文在所有三类模型家族中都显著提升了召回率。其中ETE带来的提升最大，ISE带来的提升最小，这表明模型能够更有效地利用直接的视觉证据。
tldr: 提出了ScreenASR-Bench分层基准，通过显式文本、显式视觉和隐式语义三个难度递进的层级评估视觉上下文对语音识别的辅助作用，发现视觉证据能显著提升各类模型的召回率，且直接的视觉证据比需要场景推理的隐式证据收益更大。
en_tdlr: We introduce ScreenASR-Bench, a tiered benchmark with three progressively challenging levels (explicit textual, explicit visual, and implicit semantic evidence), showing that visual context substantially improves ASR recall across ASR models, LALMs, and Omni models, with gains largest for direct visual evidence and smallest for scene-level inference.
